items.title: Solana, XRP prices jump 10% – Which altcoin has more upside left?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The recent 10% price increase for Solana indicates heightened market interest, potentially enhancing liquidity and positioning within the competitive altcoin landscape.

items.title: Solana is slashing per-block compute limits so its new 350ms speed boost doesn’t overload the network
items.whyYouShouldCare: By reducing per-block compute limits, Solana aims to maintain network stability while improving transaction speeds, which could enhance user experience and ecosystem adoption.

items.title: FalconX, Interstice Connect Canton to Ethereum, Solana and Robinhood Chain
items.whyYouShouldCare: The integration of FalconX and Interstice with Solana expands its interoperability with major platforms, potentially increasing usage and attracting more liquidity into its ecosystem.
